## ✅ Definition of Done Checklist

> All items must be checked before requesting review.

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code compiles and runs locally without errors
- [ ] ESLint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Prettier formatting applied (`npm run format`)
- [ ] No `console.log` or debug statements left in production code
- [ ] No `any` types in TypeScript (unless justified with a comment)

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests written for new logic
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] Integration/E2E tests updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Tested manually on local environment

### Documentation
- [ ] Swagger/OpenAPI comments added for new endpoints
- [ ] README or project-management docs updated (if applicable)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`

### Review
- [ ] PR is linked to an issue/task
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits format
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff before requesting review
- [ ] Breaking changes are clearly documented
